event.title: How thorough to be in code review as the team grows
event.description: You leave more than thirty comments. The new colleague starts by working through them carefully, but after the third round they message you privately: should they run everything against your bar themselves before opening a PR? Your manager has noticed their PRs are merging more slowly and books a 1:1 to ask how you are reviewing.

choices.action: Turn the standard into a team code-review checklist and roll it out
Go easier on this new colleague until they have found their feet
